title: console(record header): a url action placed at record_header on sys_user no longer renders in the 18.3 Console header menu, drawer or full page (18.2 rendered it)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Ruled: 6624172200 · letter A · 2026-11-04T06:22Z · amended by 6624212682 (no 18.3.x patch; the release note is written with the release that carries A) · 2026-11-04T06:24Z
Ruling-ref: 6624172200, 6624212682

**Filing gate ①: a reproduced regression in 18.3.0,** split out of #29946 by triage. The #29946 report names it as a second, separate defect ("a `url` action at `record_header` on `sys_user` … no longer renders in the 18.3 console's header menu, in the drawer or on the full page. 18.2 rendered it."). Its evidence is in the `objectstack-ai/duly` 18.3 browser check (`duly-18.3-browser-check/REPORT.md`, R1), from duly#185. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** `domain:ui`, the record-page header action menu (`ui/packages/app-shell`).

## What happens

- **Metadata:** a `type: 'url'` action whose `locations` include `record_header`, on `sys_user` (the duly app's member page), is served in the metadata on 18.3.0.
- **18.3.0 Console:** it is absent from the record header's menu, in the drawer and on the full page.
- **18.2.0 Console:** it rendered.

## Wanted

- Measure first. Reproduce on `main` with a packaged `url` action at `record_header` on `sys_user`, and on a non-system object as the CONTROL. Name the commit that dropped it.
- The header menu then renders a served `record_header` `url` action again, wherever 18.2 rendered it.
- Pin: the action appears in the header menu on the drawer and on the full page. The pin is red on the dropped commit's parent behaviour.

Graded p1: a shipped regression, for a patch release.

Links: #29946 (the server half from the same report), duly#185.
